items.scene: A small boy points like a general, 'I COMMAND!' (koh-MAHND), while the waitress writes his ORDER on her notepad.
A waiter ADDS each DISH ON (ah-dee-SYOHN) to a very long paper strip: THE BILL, curling down towards the rabbit's table.
A white rabbit nibbles a platter of CRUDITÉS (krew-dee-TAY), RAW carrot and celery sticks with a pot of dip.
A smiling host in a bow tie welcomes a mother, father and small son: 'REST, oh, you RAN so far!' (rehs-toh-RAHN) Welcome to the RESTAURANT.
A WAITER SWERVES (sehr-VUHR) between the tables with a plate of food held high in each hand.
A little girl at her table gazes up at a towering chocolate DESSERT (day-SEHR) with a cherry on top.
A grandfather peers at a huge MENU card through a magnifying glass, hunting for 'MORE NEW' dishes (muh-NEW).
A POOR BOAR (poor-BWAHR) in a patched waiter's jacket beams as a lady drops a little TIP into the cup he holds out.
A tired hiker slumps in her chair to REST (rehs-TOH), boots off and backpack down, in this cosy little RESTO.
A bear lays a PLACE SETTING, fork, knife and plate, and pops a silver COVER (koo-VEHR) over the plate.
